Summary
: The English translation of the Garga Samhita, an ancient Vaishnava scripture narrating the life of Krishna in seventeen cantos. Inspired by Narada to compose this scripture, Garga Muni was a sage and priest of the Yadu dynasty having undergone several austerities and penances.
This edition includes the Sanskrit text, word-by-word explanation and English translation. Alternative titles: Gargasaṃhitā (गर्गसंहिता, Gargasamhita, Saṃhitā), Śrīgargasaṃhitā (श्रीगर्गसंहित)
